species.name: Long-eared Jerboa

diary.title: Field observation
diary.body: Observed foraging near saxaul shrubs under twilight in the South Gobi. Exceptionally long auditory bullae help detect subterranean beetle activity.

diary.title: A quiet night under the saxaul
diary.body:
At dusk, the long-eared jerboa emerged from the edge of the dune field. Its enormous ears turned toward every small sound while it moved between shrubs. The night was cold, but the sand still held the day’s heat.

> Look closely. Leave quietly.

diary.title: Tracks in the dry wash
diary.body: Fresh tracks crossed the dry wash before sunrise. We recorded the route without approaching the burrow, leaving the animal’s routine undisturbed.

species.summary: Observed foraging near saxaul shrubs under twilight in the South Gobi. Exceptionally long auditory bullae help detect subterranean beetle activity.
species.factNote: Illustrative profile from the original prototype. Conservation assessments and population estimates need an editorial source review before publication.

species.name: Saiga Antelope

diary.title: Field observation
diary.body: Noticed a herd migrating across arid semi-deserts. Their signature proboscis filters dust during dry summer storms.

diary.title: A herd on the move
diary.body: The herd moved across the pale steppe in a loose line, stopping whenever the wind shifted. Their distinctive noses filter dust during the dry season.

species.name: Kakapo Parrot

diary.title: Field observation
diary.body: Heard resonant booming calls echoing through the podocarp rainforest canopy during the nocturnal lek mating season.

diary.title: Booming in the podocarp forest
diary.body: A low booming call travelled through the trees after sunset. The sanctuary team checked cameras from a distance and logged the call without interrupting the birds.

species.name: Amur Leopard

diary.title: Field observation
diary.body: Spotted fresh paw prints near snow-dusted pine ridges. Thick winter coat provides perfect camouflage in the temperate taiga.

diary.title: Pawprints after the first snow
diary.body: The first snow revealed a line of prints along the pine ridge. We marked the route on the public map at a broad regional level to protect the den site.

species.name: Mountain Gorilla

diary.title: Field observation
diary.body: Observed silverback leading family group through misty bamboo forest feeding on tender pith and wild celery.

diary.title: Mist over the bamboo
diary.body: A silverback led the group through a corridor of bamboo. The observation was made from the approved distance, with the team recording behaviour and weather only.

stories.title: Gobi Night Patrol
stories.author: Community archive
stories.body: Spent two weeks assisting researchers with acoustic monitors in sand dune valleys. Witnessed wild jerboas leaping effortlessly across moonlight.

stories.title: Rainforest Canopy Watch
stories.author: Community archive
stories.body: Helped set up camera traps and documented rare epiphytic orchids blooming high up in the tropical emergent layer.

stories.title: Steppe Conservation Camp
stories.author: Community archive
stories.body: Engaged local pastoralists in sustainable grazing practices to protect vital calving grounds for endangered saiga antelopes.

events.title: Long-eared Jerboa Night Tracking
events.body: Join our field researchers in tracking nocturnal rodent burrow systems and recording acoustic vocalizations in southern Mongolia.

events.title: Rainforest Bioacoustics 101
events.body: An online masterclass on using automated recording units (ARUs) to detect endangered bird and mammal species in dense canopies.

events.title: Kakapo Habitat Restoration Day
events.body: Hands-on sanctuary maintenance, predator-free fence checks, and native forest replanting for recovering parrot populations.
